rows.label: tlk41300012_04_msg0001
rows.name:
You caught Doon, former Chairman
Bahn's father, right?

rows.label: tlk41300012_04_msg0003
rows.name:
He's a major criminal even the Special
Investigation and Audit Bureau
couldn't catch.

rows.label: tlk41300012_04_msg0004
rows.name:
They say he wasn't just ruthless,
but had a human side too. Maybe
his son changed him a little.

rows.label: tlk41300012_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I wonder what will become of the
Avaritia Trading Company, built over
two generations by father and son...
